story:
The angel Gabriel visits Mary with amazing news, and Mary says yes to God! Grandpa Sol tells the Advent story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end. (Luke 1:26-45)

Memory verse: "Nothing is impossible with God." Luke 1:37
Memory line: Nothing is too hard for God!

Talk about it together:
Question for ages 2-3: Who came to visit Mary? (An angel!)
Question for ages 4-8: Why did the angel say do not be afraid? What did Mary say to God? When has God asked you to trust Him?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for sending Jesus. Help us trust You like Mary did. We say yes to You! Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Light a candle together (with a grown-up) or place a paper star in the window and say together, "Nothing is impossible with God!"

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Mary in her little home
Swept the floor and sang alone
A shining light came in that day
And an angel had something to say

[Chorus]
Yes, Mary said yes, yes, yes!
She trusted God with happiness
Nothing is too hard for Him
Yes, Mary said yes, yes, yes!

[Verse 2]
"Don't be afraid," the angel said
"You'll have a baby, God's own Son
His name is Jesus, the king, the One!"
Mary folded her hands up tight
"Let it be, God, I'll trust You right!"

[Chorus]
Yes, Mary said yes, yes, yes!
She trusted God with happiness
Nothing is too hard for Him
Yes, Mary said yes, yes, yes!

[Verse 3]
Mary sang and Mary smiled
Trusting God just like a child
God is faithful, God is true
He will keep His promise too

[Chorus - lifted]
Yes, Mary said yes, yes, yes!
She trusted God with happiness
Nothing is too hard for Him
Yes, Mary said yes, yes, yes!

[Outro]
Yes, yes, yes!
Yes, Mary said yes!
Yes, yes, yes!
